violation_type.title: Primary Caregiver in Registered Home Qualifications - HS Diploma or equivalent (26 TAC §747.1007(2))
violation_type.short_title: Primary Caregiver in Registered Home Qualifications - HS Diploma or equivalent
violation_type.typical_finding: The applicant do not have their high school diploma at the time of the application inspection.
